title: Window seat and alcove cabinet
summary: A storage window seat across a bay, and a tall cabinet in the alcove beside the chimney breast.
intro: A living room with a bay window and an empty alcove. The bay got a window seat with lift-up lids and grilles along the front, and the alcove got a tall cabinet with framed doors at the top and panelled doors below. Both built in MDF.

cover.alt: Living room with a tall MDF alcove cabinet and a window seat across the bay window

video.text: A look inside the seat and the cabinet, sped up a little.
